elements.text:
This study uses an Oura Ring to track sleep in collegiate athletes, comparing three groups: females who naturally menstruate, females who use a form of hormonal contraception, and males.


Everyone in the study wears an Oura Ring, completes a set of surveys on the first and final days, and answers a short daily check-in about symptoms. The two female groups also answer a daily question about their cycle or contraception.
